newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police seize 25 kgs of heroin, arrest three.
newsitem.headline: Thai police seize 25 kgs of heroin, arrest three.

text.p: Thai Narcotics Suppression police have arrested three people in northern Chiangmai province and confiscated 25 kgs (56 pounds) of heroin from them, police said on Thursday.
The three Thais of ethnic Chinese nationality were detained on Wednesday when police found the heroin in their possession in the province's Maethaeng district.
The area is near the opium-growing region known as the Golden Triangle, which straddles the borders of Thailand, Burma and Laos.
Police said the arrests followed three years of investigations into the suspects, believed to be members of a Golden Triangle drug gang.

"The arrest proves that ethnic minorities who live in our neighbouring countries are still actively producing heroin to supply to foreign countries," Police Major General Nopadol Somboontrap, chief of Narcotics Suppression, told reporters.

Meanwhile, the Thai Office Of Narcotics Control Board on Thursday burnt more than one tonne of confiscated narcotics, including 7.9 kgs (17.4 pounds) of heroin, one tonne of marijuana and other drug substances.
